metadata.basis: Krig Computer Vision Metrics: Survey, Taxonomy, and Analysis (2014)
metadata.description: World-class reference schema for classifying, evaluating, routing, and deploying computer vision feature descriptors across heterogeneous compute platforms, environmental contexts, and multimodal sensor configurations.

taxonomy_axes.shape_and_pattern: How pixels are sampled from the target image (rectangle, circle, sparse pairs, strips, deformable, volumetric)
taxonomy_axes.density: Extent of image used: Global, Regional, Sparse Local
taxonomy_axes.spectra: Scalar and vector quantities: gradient magnitude/direction, binary, color, depth, surface normals, Fourier, statistical moments

DSP_VLIW.description: Digital Signal Processor with Very Long Instruction Word for pixel-level sensor processing
DSP_VLIW.memory_profile: High-bandwidth local register file, on-chip SRAM

GPU_SIMT.description: Graphics Processing Unit with Single Instruction Multiple Threading for area operations
GPU_SIMT.memory_profile: Scatter-gather via texture sampler, shared memory tiling, global VRAM
GPU_SIMT.power_profile: Medium-High (depends on thread occupancy and memory bandwidth)

CPU_SIMD.description: Central Processing Unit with SIMD instruction extensions (SSE/AVX/NEON) for vectorized operations

CPU_Threads.description: Multi-core CPU with coarse-grain thread parallelism for algorithmic/serial code
CPU_Threads.memory_profile: Cache-coherent scatter-gather, shared system memory, page-pinned buffers

CPU_General.description: Single-threaded scalar CPU for branching-heavy, serial algorithmic code

NPU_Tensor.description: Neural Processing Unit with tensor cores for deep learning inference
NPU_Tensor.power_profile: High peak, high efficiency per TOPS

Fixed_Function_HW.description: Application-specific silicon for common vision primitives

in_place.description: Read and write same buffer; minimal memory traffic

scatter_gather.example: FREAK sparse point-pair sampling, D-NETS strip sampling

tiled.description: Block-based with overlap for area operations

scene_dynamics.static: No motion in scene or camera
scene_dynamics.slow_motion: Pedestrian walking, slow conveyor belt (<1 m/s)
scene_dynamics.fast_motion: Sports, drone flight, high-speed inspection (>60 mph)

fusion_strategies.early_fusion: Concatenate raw sensor data before feature extraction (e.g., RGB-D 4-channel input)
fusion_strategies.mid_fusion: Extract features per modality, fuse at descriptor level (e.g., SIFT vertex = 2D SIFT + 3D coord + color + texture)
fusion_strategies.late_fusion: Independent classification per modality, combine scores (e.g., weighted voting)
fusion_strategies.cross_modal_attention: Use one modality to guide attention in another (e.g., depth-guided RGB segmentation)
fusion_strategies.temporal_fusion: Integrate across time (e.g., VLBP, LBP-TOP, 3D HOG over frame volumes)

Cartesian.description: Standard x,y,z; used by most 2D descriptors
Cartesian.distortion: baked-in spherical error at FOV edges

Polar.description: r,θ; used by GLOH, shape context

Log_Polar.description: log(r),θ; used by GLOH, shape context

Radial.description: Local r,t basis at each point; used by RIFF

Gauge.description: Local differential geometry frame; used by G-SURF

hardware_affinity.gpu_notes: DoG pyramid and gradient computation parallelize well; descriptor binning with trilinear interpolation is branch-heavy
hardware_affinity.fixed_function: None standard; DCT blocks in video encoders can accelerate sub-steps

hardware_aware.memory_access_pattern: scatter_gather (gradient binning with trilinear interpolation across 4x4x8 bins)
hardware_aware.memory_bandwidth_impact: High — multiple pyramid levels, 41x41 bounding box reads per keypoint
hardware_aware.parallelism: Coarse-grain threads (tile image across CPU cores); fine-grain SIMD for gradient computation
hardware_aware.distance_function: Euclidean (L2) — or Hellinger with RootSIFT retrofit
hardware_aware.silicon_area_note: Float ALU requires ~4x die area vs integer; SIFT's float-heavy pipeline is power-expensive

context_aware.preprocessing_sensitivity: Over-smoothing destroys fine gradients (HOG research shows raw data preferred for discrimination); under-smoothing amplifies noise in DoG extrema

dynamic_routing_rules.thermal_throttle: Downgrade to ORB or CS-LBP retrofit (10x speedup, comparable accuracy)
dynamic_routing_rules.low_light: Inject CLAHE before DoG; increase contrast threshold to reject noise extrema
dynamic_routing_rules.high_motion: Switch to LPQ (blur-invariant phase) or RootSIFT (Hellinger distance more robust)

multimodal_ready.depth_extension: 3D SIFT — reformulates binning to spherical coordinates (φ,θ) over volumetric spatio-temporal region v(x,y,t)
multimodal_ready.imu_extension: SIFT-GAFD — adds gravity vector from accelerometer as global orientation constraint
multimodal_ready.rgb_d_fusion: SIFT Vertex Descriptor — 2D SIFT at RGB interest point + 3D coordinate from depth map + RGB color + LBP texture (AR pipeline, Ch.8)
multimodal_ready.temporal_extension: 3D SIFT over frame volumes for action recognition
multimodal_ready.cross_modal_calibration: Requires pixel-aligned RGB-D registration; stereo rectification for depth accuracy

retrofits_and_variants.name: SIFT-GLOH
retrofits_and_variants.change: Log-polar binning (17 bins) instead of Cartesian 4x4

retrofits_and_variants.name: SIFER
retrofits_and_variants.change: Cosine-modulated Gaussian filter, 6 scales per octave

taxonomy_axes.sampling_pattern: Trained high-variance point-pairs (256 pairs from 31x31 region)

hardware_aware.compute_complexity: O(N) per keypoint — two orders of magnitude faster than SIFT

hardware_affinity.gpu_notes: Hamming distance (XOR + popcount) is inefficient on GPU SIMT; best on CPU with SSE4.2/AVX2 popcnt instruction
hardware_affinity.dsp_notes: Point-pair comparisons are simple threshold operations suitable for VLIW

hardware_aware.memory_access_pattern: scatter_gather (256 sparse point-pair reads from 31x31 patch)
hardware_aware.power_profile: Very Low (integer-only, no float ALU needed)
hardware_aware.parallelism: SIMD (NEON/AVX for parallel XOR + popcount across 256-bit vectors)
hardware_aware.distance_function: Hamming (XOR + bit count — single-cycle on modern CPUs with popcnt)
hardware_aware.silicon_area_note: Integer ALU only; ~4x smaller than float ALU; ideal for mobile SoC

geometric.rotation: Full (FAST9 + Harris + Rosin intensity centroid orientation)

incompleteness.noise: Medium (5x5 integral image smoothing per point)

preprocessing_pipeline: Gaussian blur (light, for FAST corner detection)
integral image (5x5 smoothing for BRIEF points)
context_aware.preprocessing_sensitivity: Minimal — binary comparisons tolerate wide illumination range; compare threshold tunable for noise

dynamic_routing_rules.thermal_throttle: ORB is already the fallback; reduce pyramid levels from 8 to 4
dynamic_routing_rules.low_light: Increase FAST threshold sensitivity; inject bilateral filter before detection
dynamic_routing_rules.high_motion: Switch to FREAK (coarse-to-fine cascade rejects bad matches faster)

multimodal_ready.depth_extension: RGB-D ORB-SLAM — uses depth map for scale initialization and 3D point cloud
multimodal_ready.imu_extension: ORB-SLAM3 — tightly-coupled IMU preintegration for 6DOF pose
multimodal_ready.rgb_d_fusion: ORB keypoints on RGB + depth for 3D map points
multimodal_ready.temporal_extension: Frame-to-frame tracking with constant velocity model
multimodal_ready.cross_modal_calibration: RGB-D extrinsic calibration for depth-to-color alignment

taxonomy_axes.sampling_pattern: Foveal centered trained pairs (45 pairs, coarse-to-fine cascade of 4×16-byte groups)

hardware_aware.compute_complexity: O(1) per keypoint after AGAST detection — 0.1% of SIFT compute
hardware_aware.memory_access_pattern: scatter_gather (foveal pattern with variable-radius Gaussian smoothing regions)
hardware_aware.memory_bandwidth_impact: Low — 64 bytes, coarse-to-fine cascade allows early rejection (first 16 bytes reject 90% of non-matches)
hardware_aware.parallelism: SIMD for Hamming distance; cascade enables branch-prediction-friendly early exit
hardware_aware.distance_function: Hamming (cascaded: coarse 16-byte match first, then fine)
hardware_aware.silicon_area_note: Integer-only; cascade logic reduces average compute by 4-10x vs full descriptor comparison

preprocessing_pipeline: AGAST corner detection over scale space

dynamic_routing_rules.thermal_throttle: Use only first 16-byte cascade (coarse match) for 4x speedup
dynamic_routing_rules.low_light: Increase Gaussian smoothing radius in outer rings
dynamic_routing_rules.high_motion: FREAK is preferred over ORB due to viewpoint robustness

multimodal_ready.depth_extension: RGB-D FREAK — depth map provides scale constraint for AGAST
multimodal_ready.imu_extension: Gravity-aligned orientation from IMU replaces long-pair orientation
multimodal_ready.rgb_d_fusion: FREAK on RGB + depth for 3D feature anchoring

taxonomy_axes.sampling_pattern: Symmetric pairs (short segments for descriptor, long segments for orientation)

hardware_aware.compute_complexity: O(N) — order of magnitude faster than SURF
hardware_aware.memory_access_pattern: scatter_gather (60 Gaussian-smoothed sample points in concentric rings)
hardware_aware.parallelism: SIMD for Hamming; integral images for Gaussian approximation
hardware_aware.silicon_area_note: Integer-only; integral image computation reuses DSP/GPU box filter hardware

preprocessing_pipeline: Gaussian smoothing at each sample point

taxonomy_axes.shape_topology: HAAR rectangles within 20x20 grid (rotated to dominant orientation)
taxonomy_axes.sampling_pattern: Dense 4x4 sub-regions with 5x5 sample points each
spectra_type: Integral Box Filter (HAAR wavelet responses dx, dy, |dx|, |dy|)

hardware_aware.compute_complexity: O(N²) — one order of magnitude faster than SIFT

hardware_affinity.gpu_notes: Integral image computation and HAAR responses parallelize well on GPU; MOPED provides optimized GPGPU SURF
hardware_affinity.fixed_function: Integral image can use DSP box filter

hardware_aware.memory_bandwidth_impact: Medium — integral image is computed once and reused
hardware_aware.parallelism: SIMD for HAAR responses; threads for grid regions
hardware_aware.silicon_area_note: Float ALU required for descriptor; integral image uses integer accumulation

geometric.rotation: Full (sliding sector window for dominant orientation)

dynamic_routing_rules.thermal_throttle: Switch to U-SURF (upright, no rotation) for 2x speedup
dynamic_routing_rules.low_light: SURF integral images are robust; minimal preprocessing needed

taxonomy_axes.shape_topology: Rectangular (64x128 detector window, 8x8 cells, 2x2 block normalization)

hardware_affinity.gpu_notes: Gradient computation and histogram binning are ideal SIMT area operations; sliding window parallelizes across detector positions
hardware_affinity.npu_notes: HOG is a common pre-CNN feature for NPU-based classifiers
hardware_affinity.fixed_function: Video encoder motion estimation blocks can compute gradient-like features

hardware_aware.memory_bandwidth_impact: High — dense computation over entire image, 4608 floats per 64x128 window
hardware_aware.parallelism: SIMT (one thread per cell or per detector window)
hardware_aware.silicon_area_note: No float needed for gradient computation ([-1,0,1] filters); float needed for normalization

environmental_robustness.illumination: High (L2 block normalization provides local contrast invariance)

incompleteness.noise: Low (raw data preferred — smoothing degrades accuracy by 27%)

preprocessing_pipeline: NONE — raw RGB data preferred (key finding: smoothing destroys discrimination)
context_aware.preprocessing_sensitivity: CRITICAL: Do NOT apply Gaussian smoothing or noise filtering before HOG. The abrupt edges at fine scales are required for accuracy. Only post-processing normalization is used.

dynamic_routing_rules.thermal_throttle: Reduce detector window overlap; use PHOG (pyramid) for coarser classification
dynamic_routing_rules.low_light: HOG works on raw data; minimal preprocessing; consider switching to LBP for extreme low light

multimodal_ready.depth_extension: 3D HOG — spatio-temporal gradient orientation over volume v(x,y,t) using integral video
multimodal_ready.rgb_d_fusion: HOG on RGB + depth gradient for RGB-D object recognition
multimodal_ready.temporal_extension: 3D HOG over frame stacks for action recognition
multimodal_ready.cross_modal_calibration: None required for 2D; RGB-D alignment for 3D

taxonomy_axes.sampling_pattern: Center-boundary pairs (8 neighbors vs center pixel)

hardware_aware.compute_complexity: O(1) per pixel — 8 comparisons + 8 bit shifts

hardware_affinity.gpu_notes: Trivially parallelizable — one thread per pixel; ideal for GPU compute shader
hardware_affinity.fixed_function: Can be implemented in sensor ISP as point operation
hardware_affinity.dsp_notes: 8 comparisons per pixel fit perfectly into VLIW instruction word

hardware_aware.memory_bandwidth_impact: Very Low — 1 byte output per pixel, minimal reads
hardware_aware.distance_function: Hamming (for bit vectors) or Chi-squared / histogram intersection (for LBP histograms)
hardware_aware.silicon_area_note: Minimal — can be implemented in sensor ISP silicon at near-zero cost

environmental_robustness.illumination: High (monotonic gray-level invariant — only relative ordering matters)

geometric.rotation: Full (RILBP variant via circular bit shifting)

preprocessing_pipeline: Optional: compare threshold adjustment for noise
context_aware.preprocessing_sensitivity: Minimal — LBP is inherently robust to monotonic illumination changes; threshold handles noise

dynamic_routing_rules.thermal_throttle: LBP is already minimal compute; use uniform patterns (56 bins) to reduce histogram size
dynamic_routing_rules.low_light: Increase compare threshold to ignore noise; switch to LTP (ternary) for constant-gray regions

multimodal_ready.depth_extension: LBP on depth maps for surface texture
multimodal_ready.rgb_d_fusion: OCLBP (Opponent Color LBP) — 9 histograms across RGB channel pairs
multimodal_ready.temporal_extension: VLBP (Volume LBP over parallel planes), LBP-TOP (orthogonal planes in x,y,t volume)

hardware_aware.compute_complexity: O(V) where V = volume of cuboid

hardware_affinity.gpu_notes: 3D gradient computation and icosahedron projection are ideal for compute shaders; integral video enables constant-time cuboid queries

hardware_aware.memory_access_pattern: scatter_gather (3D volume access, non-contiguous in memory)
hardware_aware.memory_bandwidth_impact: Very High — volumetric data, multiple frame reads
hardware_aware.parallelism: SIMT (one thread per voxel or per cuboid cell)
hardware_aware.silicon_area_note: Float ALU required; integral video requires 32-bit accumulation

multimodal_ready.temporal_extension: Native — operates over frame volumes v(x,y,t)
multimodal_ready.binning_method: 20-faced icosahedron projection for gradient orientation quantization

hardware_aware.compute_complexity: O(V) — surface normal computation per voxel + 4D projection

hardware_affinity.gpu_notes: Surface normal computation from depth maps is a classic GPU compute shader task; 4D polychoron projection parallelizes
hardware_affinity.npu_notes: 4D normal histograms can be fed directly into tensor cores for classification

hardware_aware.memory_access_pattern: scatter_gather (non-contiguous 3D volume access for normal computation)
hardware_aware.memory_bandwidth_impact: Very High — depth sequence volume, normal computation requires 3D neighborhood
hardware_aware.parallelism: SIMT (one thread per depth pixel per frame)
hardware_aware.silicon_area_note: Float ALU required for normal computation and 4D projection

native_modalities: Depth video sequences (ToF or structured light)
multimodal_ready.rgb_d_fusion: Can combine with RGB features for late fusion
multimodal_ready.cross_modal_calibration: Depth camera intrinsic calibration for accurate normals

hardware_aware.descriptor_memory_bytes: Variable (200-500+ bytes: 36 floats FFT + 36 ints radial + shape factors)
hardware_aware.compute_complexity: O(P) for perimeter tracing + O(N log N) for FFT

hardware_affinity.gpu_notes: Morphology and segmentation can run on GPU; perimeter tracing and FFT are serial/algorithmic
hardware_affinity.dsp_notes: Thresholding and point operations for segmentation

hardware_aware.memory_access_pattern: algorithmic (perimeter tracing is inherently serial; non-local data access)
hardware_aware.memory_bandwidth_impact: Medium — depends on image size and number of objects
hardware_aware.parallelism: Coarse-grain threads (one thread per segmented object); morphology on GPU
hardware_aware.distance_function: Multiple: Euclidean (shape factors), EMD (histograms), Fourier magnitude comparison
hardware_aware.silicon_area_note: Float64 needed for FFT accuracy; large die area for double-precision ALU

environmental_robustness.illumination: Low (requires careful thresholding and segmentation; uneven illumination breaks boundary detection)

incompleteness.occlusion: Medium (partial perimeter can still yield shape factors)

context_aware.preprocessing_sensitivity: EXTREME — shape descriptors are the most preprocessing-dependent family. Wrong threshold = wrong shape = wrong measurement. Physical lighting control is preferred over algorithmic correction.

dynamic_routing_rules.thermal_throttle: Reduce morphology iterations; use simpler shape factors (area, perimeter, centroid only)
dynamic_routing_rules.low_light: Inject CLAHE + adaptive thresholding; consider switching to texture-based segmentation

multimodal_ready.depth_extension: Depth-based segmentation (e.g., automobile above roadway surface in Ch.8 pipeline)
multimodal_ready.rgb_d_fusion: RGB color + depth segmentation for region identification (hood, roof, trunk)
multimodal_ready.coordinate_space: Cartesian (bounding box) + Polar (radial line segments for Fourier descriptor)
multimodal_ready.temporal_extension: Frame-to-frame tracking via centroid + shape factor matching

taxonomy_axes.sampling_pattern: Overlapping Gaussian convolution kernels at 8 orientations

hardware_aware.compute_complexity: O(N²) — 40% faster than SIFT for dense matching

hardware_affinity.gpu_notes: Convolution orientation maps are ideal GPU compute shader tasks; recursive Gaussian computation optimizes memory

hardware_aware.memory_bandwidth_impact: Medium — convolution maps computed once, reused for all pixels
hardware_aware.parallelism: SIMT (one thread per pixel for dense computation)
hardware_aware.silicon_area_note: Float ALU for convolutions; recursive Gaussian reduces multiply count

geometric.rotation: Full (rotate sampling grid, not recompute maps)

incompleteness.occlusion: High (binary occlusion masks to ignore occluded regions)

multimodal_ready.depth_extension: Daisy on depth maps for surface matching
multimodal_ready.unique_feature: Binary occlusion masks for handling partial visibility

action.reduce_descriptor_cascade: Use only first 16 bytes of FREAK

action.enable_fusion: Mid-fusion: RGB features + 3D coordinates + surface normals
